It is not evidence that the work is correct, that the commands check the right things, or that the specification was satisfied. The commands ran code in this tree, including tests and build scripts the change may have edited; the tree was the same before and after the run, which cannot see an edit reverted during the run. The base checks put the base's tests back to see whether they still pass, and their runs are observed beside this evidence, never part of it.
